# tuna_tunnels (Data Source)

List of tunnels. Tunnels are ephemeral and created by agents, so they are read-only in Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tuna_tunnels" "all" {}

output "active_tunnels" {
  value = [for t in data.tuna_tunnels.all.tunnels : t.public_url if t.active]
}
```
